skip_reason: The AgentPayy skill violates two banned capability criteria: (1) Authenticated/Stateful Network — generating a Coinbase MPC Wallet via CDP and executing real USDC transactions on Base L2 require real API keys (CDP credentials) and live blockchain access, which cannot be mocked in an isolated container without those secrets; (2) Incomplete/Stub Documentation — the SKILL.md is a shallow marketing document with a single trivial code snippet, minimal technical depth, no API reference, and no proprietary CLI flags or configuration schemas to test against, making it impossible to design a task that discriminates between an agent reading the SKILL.md versus relying on general training data.
